backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling user profiles and posts with automatic profile creation and authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining light/dark theme color variables and global styling.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file setting up the app container and loading the main React entrypoint.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main router setup integrating AuthGate, theme provider, layout, and routing for feed, create, and profile pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Wrapper that blocks access until authentication initializes, showing login UI or rendering children.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button wired to Internet Identity with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: App layout with header, footer, and responsive navigation for feed, create, and profile.
frontend/src/components/posts/PostCard.t: Displays a post with author info, timestamp, content, optional image, and delete actions with confirmation.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileH: Renders a user's profile header with avatar, name, handle, bio, and principal badge.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreatePost.ts: Provides a mutation to create posts, including optional file upload with progress, and invalidates related caches.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Returns the current user's profile and loading state using useGetCallerUserProfile.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeletePost.ts: Provides a mutation to delete a post and invalidates feed and userPosts queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useFeed.ts: Fetches and returns all posts sorted by newest, enabled once the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity auth state, login, logout, and provides identity via context.
frontend/src/hooks/useProfile.ts: Fetches the caller's profile and provides a mutation to update it, with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains reusable profile-related queries and mutations backed by the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserPosts.ts: Fetches posts belonging to the authenticated user, sorted by newest first.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom light/dark theme color variables.
frontend/src/lib/mediaValidation.ts: Validates media files for size and allowed image/video MIME types.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Provides a form for creating posts with captions and optional media upload, including validation, previews, and progress handling.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Loads and displays a feed of posts with loading, error, and empty states using PostCard components.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays the signed-in user's profile and posts, with editing capabilities for display name and bio.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, typography, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, features, requirements, and image needs for the social media app.
